tools.name: create_campaign_pack
tools.description: Create or open a public Superdraft workspace for a business website, requesting two email drafts and two Instagram posts with images designed as part of those drafts. Anyone with the workspace link can view and edit the saved content. Uses the shared public generation allowance and may resume failed

tools.name: get_campaign_status
tools.description: Read the saved public campaign status for a business website. Returns queued, running, ready, partial, or failed and the workspace link. Does not start or retry generation. Use the canonical website_url returned by create_campaign_pack when available.

tools.name: get_campaign_pack
tools.description: Read available public starter email subjects, preview text, bodies, Instagram captions, image links, and draft links for a business website. Includes slot states so missing drafts are not mistaken for finished work. Reads only public content; does not generate, edit, send, publish, or access private

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_campaign_pack, get_campaign_pack · Private data: create_campaign_pack, get_campaign_pack · Public sink: create_campaign_pack, get_campaign_pack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_campaign_pack, get_campaign_pack · Private data: create_campaign_pack, get_campaign_pack · Public sink: create_campaign_pack, get_campaign_pack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
